name: Miro
description: Miro lets agents read board content and create diagrams, documents, and tables on boards the user can access. Each user signs in to their own Miro account through the browser.

prompts.text: Summarize the sticky notes on my retrospective board.
Create a flowchart of the user sign-up process on a new board.
Turn the ideas on this board into a short product spec.

apps.name: Miro
apps.description: Board reading and diagram creation, over Miro's MCP server with browser sign-in.
